#!/bin/sh
# Deploy pushed content to the web root served by nginx on port 8080
WEBROOT=/srv/www
mkdir -p "$WEBROOT"
while read oldrev newrev refname; do
  case "$refname" in
    refs/heads/*) ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
  branch="${refname#refs/heads/}"

    echo "Deploying $branch to $WEBROOT"
    GIT_WORK_TREE="$WEBROOT" git checkout -f "refs/heads/$branch" 2>&1
  fi
done
EOF
